verdict.rationale: LocalAI's own docs show it loading a Q8_0 GGUF quantized model and handling ggml/gguf models, so it can run 8-bit integer-quantized weights. Nothing in the evidence covers the lower-bit end of the range or memory-footprint savings. Missing for 10: evidence of very low-bit (e.g., 2–4-bit) quantization support, documentation of the supported quantization formats/range, memory-footprint reduction claims, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can reduce memory footprint using integer quantization ranging from very low-bit to 8-bit precision

citations.quote: the autoparser detects the tool call format for any ggml/gguf model that was trained with tool support
